answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to a unique non-outsourceable puzzle. Every agent must solve a challenge whose answer is locked to one secret key it alone holds; because solving leaks the key, the work cannot be outsourced or copied. An attacker who tries to forge a fleet of fake peers must grind a fresh unique puzzle per identity, paying full compute each time. Two identities reusing one key are slashed. The network pays a small nectar-like reward only to keys proven freshly solved, so cloning grants no ivory edge-each duplicate costs as much as the first.
